The '''Bastion Line''' was a fleet of ships serving the [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] during the [[DarkStryder Campaign]]. The fleet, along with the [[Raptor Line]], was called to protect [[Kathol]] from [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces under [[Kursk Mal'ia]] and the [[Bothan Combat Response Element]] and fought in the following [[Battle of Kathol System]].

The Bastion Line was commanded during this battle by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brannij]], who flew the ''Bastion'', which suffered heavy damage. When the battle turned in favor of the Republic, Brannij realized that Sarne was only interested in saving himself and decided to act out for the safety of his fleet. Once Sarne was defeated, Brannij took the Bastion Line and other remaining starships and fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

In addition to the fleet's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''Bastion'', the Line also contained the following ships.

*one [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian Manufacturing Corporation]] [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]]
*one [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]]
